title: The Impossible Test: A 2024 Unsolvable Dataset and A Chance for an AGI Quiz

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on 675 fundamentally unsolvable problems to measure whether they hallucinate plausible but incorrect answers to satisfy user prompts rather than admitting ignorance (epistemic humility).
Comparing how models apply safety guardrails and respond to speculative philosophical or psychological questions versus more proof-based challenges, like those in physics or cosmology.

Using multiple-choice distractors that deliberately mimic statistical norms, common phrasing, or default test patterns to test if models select an answer based on its familiarity rather than reasoning.
